topic: The clock that stopped at the precise moment its owner died — every generation
hook: This family's clock stops every time someone dies.
script: This family's clock stops every time someone dies. The Cornelius clock, an antique grandfather clock passed through a German family, stopped functioning at the exact moment of death of each successive owner — across five generations. Watchmakers found no mechanical reason for the stoppages. The clock would restart spontaneously days after each funeral. It sits in a museum in Bavaria. It has not stopped since the last owner died in 1987. Follow for objects that behave like they're alive.
